title: Lorwyn Eclipsed Promos: card flavor text

entities.name: Maralen
entities.description: The fae ascendant who rules as Queen of Glen Elendra; more forgiving than Oona but her rule is no less absolute.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: Former ruler of the fae, less forgiving than Maralen.

entities.name: Glen Elendra
entities.description: The home of the fae, Maralen's domain.

entities.name: Kithkin
entities.description: A people bound mind to mind and heart to heart through the thoughtweft.

entities.name: Thoughtweft
entities.description: The mental bond that unites the kithkin.

entities.name: Flamekin
entities.description: A people who live on the slopes of Mount Kulrath.

entities.name: Mount Kulrath
entities.description: A mountain whose slopes the flamekin know.

entities.name: Kirol
entities.description: A first-year who hated being a pawn in Morcant's game and believed dawnglove should be preserved.

entities.name: Morcant
entities.description: One who plays a game using Kirol as a pawn and suggested dawnglove's potency.

entities.name: Dawnglove
entities.description: A potent substance that could tip the balance of power.

entities.name: Auntie Wort
entities.description: A figure from tales.

entities.name: Velis Vel
entities.description: The place where the Mirrormind Crown was forged.

entities.name: Mirrormind Crown
entities.description: A crown forged in Velis Vel, stolen by a merrow and sold to a kithkin.

entities.name: Doran
entities.description: One who warns that the passing years rot one with scars.

entities.name: Lluwen
entities.description: One who feels she belongs somewhere, just not here.

entities.name: Tam
entities.description: A first-year concerned with odds.

entities.name: Abigale
entities.description: An eloquent first-year associated with poetry.

entities.name: Merrow
entities.description: A people, one of whom swiped the Mirrormind Crown.

entities.name: Boggarts
entities.description: Creatures preyed upon by faeries while snoring.

entities.name: Faeries
entities.description: Fae who swarm to snoring boggarts; ruled by Maralen.

entities.name: Elves
entities.description: A people of Lorwyn.

events.summary: Maralen declares Glen Elendra her domain and herself its Queen.
events.quote: "This is *my* domain, and *I* am its Queen."

events.summary: Kirol resents being a pawn in Morcant's game and wants dawnglove preserved rather than used.
events.quote: Kirol hated being a pawn in Morcant's game.

events.summary: The Mirrormind Crown is forged in Velis Vel, stolen by a merrow, and sold to a kithkin.
events.quote: Forged in Velis Vel, swiped by a clever merrow, and sold to a curious kithkin.
